instruction: I need to configure LibreOffice Impress to disable the automatic saving feature. This way I have full control over when my presentations are saved. Please turn off the auto-save option in the settings.

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling the auto-save feature in LibreOffice Impress. The evaluator checks the registrymodifications.xcu file to verify that the AutoSave setting under /org.openoffice.Office.Common/Save/Document is set to 'false'. This is similar in complexity to the original task which also involves modifying LibreOffice configuration settings.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly parses LibreOffice configuration XML file (registrymodifications.xcu)
Metric function uses correct XPath to locate AutoSave setting at /org.openoffice.Office.Common/Save/Document
Logic correctly verifies that AutoSave value is 'false' (disabled state)
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the exact requirement in the instruction (disable auto-save)
Proper error handling with try-catch for XML parsing errors
Correct default behavior: returns 0.0 if setting not found (assumes auto-save enabled by default)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: The metric function accepts an 'expected' parameter but doesn't use it (commented as 'not used'). While this doesn't affect correctness, the function signature could be simplified or the expected parameter could be removed if truly not needed.
